classification: Post-freeze source extraction and gross exposure quantification; original value not changed
method: Reported unit counts constrain gross share exposure, and contemporaneous note gives option intrinsic values/strikes/lives. Gross units valued at model price are a sensitivity, not observed market fair value. Grant-date average fair values and unearned book expense are not interchangeable with current claim value. Reserved shares for future grants are not outstanding claims.
noDoubleCounting: A full legacy claim deduction must first remove the corresponding future legacy amortization from projected operating expenses, retaining all future NEW grant/replacement compensation cost. Alternatively use a consistently forecast fully diluted share path with equivalent compensation treatment. Aggregate margin forecasts do not isolate legacy amortization, vesting/performance probabilities or tax effects; do not apply both whole-unit dilution and untouched legacy expense. Unrecognized compensation totals cannot simply be added back at face value.
remainingGap: Need grant-cohort vesting/service schedules, performance conditions, legacy/new grant expense split, forfeitures, actual option counts, valuation-date price and option volatility/dividend inputs, plus tax treatment and cover-date rollforward. Therefore these cases still do not contain a verified net legacy-claim bridge.
